label: Single tuned MnCAV gain set; replaces the former nominal default and the mississippi-20240607-fixed-scale profile
referenceAndMap: Receiver-reference-v3 study inputs and fixed map; coarse source horizons regenerated with the perception of commit b49ad5f (intensity-responsibility sign moments)
objective: Square root of the mean of four squared RMSE ratios (position all frames, heading after 2 s; LiDAR only and GNSS+LiDAR) to the former nominal gains [4,4,12,4] with scale 16, computed separately on the tuning segment (frames 1-700) and the held-out segment (701-1169); the selected set minimizes the mean of both segments averaged over the two LiDAR channels
searchScope: Grid plus refinement: overlap 280 candidates (kp 2-160, kpsi 0.125-8, scale 1-256), registration 72 candidates (kp 4-80, kpsi 0.5-4, scale 4-128); 24 candidates at kp<=4 failed the continuous ISS LMIs; no exhaustive or global optimum claim
designRoute: Continuous seven-state ISS-LMI verification of every candidate, then the same numerical discretization
scope: Specific to this recording, reference/map, nominal MnCAV motion model and search objective. The held-out segment is the later part of the same drive, not an independent drive. Runtime must verify the continuous LMIs under the declared domain; this label is not a full-trajectory ISS certificate or cross-dataset validation.
